carried_set_rule: One estimator is judged: the fused tracker named in carried_models (the frozen IMM reference with the frozen T2's range fused in, k 4, every 6 samples), with T2 bound by model_digests and the fused file tied to T2's prediction file by tma-g5's prediction chain. G5 exactly as Annex C §C.5 (97.5% intervals kept); pass if every gated check passes, fail if any fails, otherwise inconclusive, with one re-score on a larger fresh seed.
change: Phase 4c (SRD Annex C §C.11, owner decision 31): judge the fused tracker at G5 unchanged. The frozen reference IMM takes, after each bearing update and every 6 samples from zig_index + 1, T2's range as a log-range measurement with sd 4 × T2's stated log-range sd. One state carries range and velocity. Nothing is trained.
rationale: Phase 4b's hybrid passed G5 but reports range and velocity from different estimators; before any manoeuvre its range is 1.47 x the IMM's and its settled velocity passes largely by copying the IMM's. Fusing T2's range into the IMM keeps one state. k and M were chosen on seed-211 validation from a 12-variant grid as the middle of the plateau of the smallest G5 margin (u = M k^2 from 48 to 192; spec 014 R2). In-sample, tma-g5 on validation: overall range 0.806 [0.780, 0.829], overall course 0.930 [0.907, 0.960], settled range 0.846 [0.801, 0.889], course 0.908 [0.873, 0.952], speed 0.882 [0.836, 0.933] x the IMM; before any manoeuvre range 0.94 x. NEES is no worse than the IMM's. Forecast before scoring: P(G5 pass on seed 214) about 85%; the weakest check is overall course.
